_note: Registered on 2026-10-10 after the v7 main run was scored, at the reader's request; disclosed in the article as a post-hoc change. Applies to every version and both candidates.
old_rule: A side wins if its 5-seed average lead exceeds 50% of the average seed-to-seed spread.
new_rule: Seeds are compared in pairs (each seed gives both candidates the same shocks and engine noise). A side wins an indicator only if it is better in every seed. Differences smaller than an official tolerance band are a tie: primary balance ±0.25 pp of GDP (arcabouço target band), inflation ±1.5 pp (inflation-target band).
why: The old rule ignored the common-random-numbers design, so consistent differences (e.g. homicides lower for Lula in 5 of 5 seeds and in 100 of 100 engine-noise replays) counted as ties, while deterministic indicators with almost no spread (primary balance) turned economically trivial gaps into wins.
effect_on_main_v7: Old rule: Lula 3 x 1. New rule: Lula 5 x 3 (Lula gains homicides and approval; Flavio gains economy and unemployment; the primary balance becomes a tie inside the ±0.25 band, debt keeps public accounts with Flavio).
real_record: The real-record comparison has one value per government, so it keeps its own registered tie thresholds (data/track_record_rules.json).
